blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
blocks.zh: 在NLP中,通过经验风险最小化(ERM)培训的模型常常利用虚伪的关联性,如方言标记,而牺牲了强健的语言特征,从而贬低了他们的分散性(OOD)泛化. 将风险最小化(IRM)的目的是通过确定在各种环境之间保持稳定的预测性关系来抑制这种快捷方式,但其对于NLP的实际用途仍然争论不休。 我们使用一个因果驱动的框架,在三个快捷生成机制下评估IRM:标签生成的特性,混淆,以及选择偏差. 我们的结果表明,IRM成功地拒绝了跨越评估的因果结构和抗因果结构的捷径,包括在有限的环境变化和不断增加的标签噪音下。 然后,我们将分析范围扩大到两个不那么受限制的环境:Bias的性别专业协会和ActorCorr中装满的演员姓名快捷键。 这些实验表明,无常的学习可以减轻更现实的文字快捷方式,而精密有意义的特征则需要仔细校准无常的处罚.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Predictive success in NLP often masks a vulnerability: models frequently rely on dataset-specific biases rather than genuine robust linguistic features. Under the ERM paradigm ( Vapnik, 2013 ) , models exploit statistical shortcuts, such as negation words ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ) , syntactic heuristics ( McCoy et al., 2019 ) , or demographic dialectal markers ( Blodgett et al., 2020 ) , leading to catastrophic performance drops when encountering real-world distribution shifts where these biases no longer hold.
blocks.zh: NLP的预测成功往往掩盖了一种脆弱性:模型往往依赖数据集特有的偏差,而不是真正的强健语言特征。 根据机构风险管理模式(Vapnik,2013年),模型利用统计快捷方式,如否定词(Gurururangan等,2018年),综合heuristics(McCoy等,2019年),或人口方言标记(Blodgett等,2020年)等,在出现这些偏见不再存在的现实世界分布变化时,导致灾难性性能下降。

blocks.en: To mitigate this lack of robustness, several strategies have been proposed. Domain adaptation methods ( Ben-David et al., 2010 ; Ganin et al., 2016 ) and sample reweighting techniques ( Shimodaira, 2000 ) aim to align distributions or correct known selection biases. However, these techniques face a major limitation: they generally require prior knowledge of the test distribution, either through access to unlabeled target data or by explicitly identifying the specific confounding variables to be rebalanced. In many real-world NLP applications, this target distribution is unknown or subject to unpredictable shifts. In this context, IRM ( Arjovsky et al., 2019 ) has emerged as a powerful theoretical alternative. The core originality of IRM lies in its ability to operate without any information regarding the target distribution. By leveraging data partitioned into multiple distinct training environments , IRM enforces a strict learning constraint. It compels the representation to discard features whose predictive validity fluctuates, isolating only those stable, invariant correlations that yield simultaneously optimal classifiers across all environments. In doing so, IRM seeks to capture robust linguistic principles that guarantee optimal generalization, even to domains entirely unseen during training (Figure 1 ). Despite these theoretical promises, the practical effectiveness of IRM remains heavily debated. While large-scale benchmarks in machine learning have questioned its out-of-the-box superiority over ERM in standard domain generalization ( Gulrajani and Lopez-Paz, 2021 ) , evaluations on specific NLP tasks have also tempered expectations ( Koh et al., 2021 ) , notably regarding its capacity for robust bias mitigation ( Dranker et al., 2021 ) . To understand why cross-environment invariant methods lack effectiveness in NLP, we must move beyond treating spurious correlations as an undifferentiated problem. A non-causal correlation between a spurious textual variable and the label Y Y can originate from distinctly different mechanisms: a common cause, a selection bias, or a label-generated feature ( Pearl, 2009 ) . As these distinct generative processes result in structurally different distributional shifts, investigating how IRM responds to each specific spurious mechanism might help clarify the precise conditions required for its success in NLP. Furthermore, IRM’s core assumption, that spurious correlations must fluctuate across environments, raises questions about the required magnitude of variation and its behavior when the genuine task-relevant signal is degraded.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这种缺乏活力的情况,提出了几项战略。 域调整方法(Ben-David等,2010年;Ganin等,2016年)和样本再加权技术(Shimodaira,2000年)旨在调整分布或纠正已知的选择偏差。 然而,这些技术面临一个重大限制:它们一般要求事先了解测试分布情况,要么通过获取未贴标签的目标数据,要么通过明确确定需要重新平衡的具体混淆变量。 在许多现实世界的NLP应用中,这个目标分布是未知的,或者受到不可预知的转变. 在这方面,IRM(Arjovsky等,2019年)已经成为一个强大的理论替代品. IRM的核心原创性在于其运作能力没有关于目标分布的任何信息. 通过利用被分割成多个不同培训环境的数据,综合管理机制实施严格的学习限制。 它迫使代表放弃其预测有效性波动的特征,只隔离那些同时产生所有环境中最佳分类器的稳定、不相干的相关性。 在这样做时,IRM力求抓住强有力的语言原则,保障最佳的通俗化,甚至到培训期间完全看不见的领域(图1)。 尽管有这些理论上的承诺,但风险管理的实际效力仍然受到激烈辩论。 虽然机器学习方面的大规模基准质疑其在标准域通论方面相对于机构风险管理的外在优势(Gulrajani和Lopez-Paz, 2021年),但对于具体NLP任务的评价也缓解了人们的期望(Koh等人, 2021年),尤其是对其有力减少偏见的能力(Drancker等人, 2021年)。 为了理解跨环境的无差别方法为何在NLP中缺乏有效性,我们必须超越将虚假的关联作为一个无差别的问题来对待. 一个虚假的文字变量和标签Y之间的非因果关系可以来自截然不同的机制:一个共同的原因,一个选择偏好,或者一个标签生成的特性(Pearl,2009.). 由于这些独特的分层过程导致结构上不同的分布变化,调查IRM如何对每一个具体的虚假机制作出反应可能有助于澄清在NLP中取得成功所需的确切条件。 此外,IRM的核心假设是,虚假的相互关系必须在各个环境之间起起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起起伏起伏起伏起起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起起起起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起伏起起相起起起相起起起起相起相起相起起起相起相起相起相起相起相起

First, Section 4.2 distinguishes three shortcut-generating mechanisms, label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias, across causal and anti-causal tasks. blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Applications of invariant learning to NLP have produced mixed results. In the WILDS benchmark, Koh et al. (2021) evaluated IRM alongside several other methods for improving robustness to naturally occurring domain and subpopulation shifts, including NLP tasks, but found no consistent advantage over standard training. Focusing more directly on natural language inference, Dranker et al. (2021) similarly reported limited benefits when natural MNLI genres were treated as environments. However, IRM performed more favorably when environments were explicitly constructed to differ in the prevalence of a known bias, emphasizing the importance of environment definition. Other studies have adapted invariant learning more directly to NLP-specific objectives. Peyrard et al. (2022) introduced an invariant language-modeling objective and obtained clearer benefits in controlled bias-removal experiments than across broad, heterogeneous corpora. For demographic bias mitigation, Zhou et al. (2023) proposed Causal-Debias, which identifies bias-relevant factors as non-causal and label-relevant factors as causal, intervenes on the former across demographic groups, and applies an invariant learning loss during downstream fine-tuning. Their experiments show that this task-aware formulation can reduce stereotypical associations while preserving downstream performance. Taken together, these studies suggest that invariant learning is most effective when the environments or interventions are explicitly designed to expose the targeted bias. Our work complements these approaches by studying whether IRM’s behavior depends on the mechanism that generates the spurious correlation and by extending the evaluation from controlled synthetic shortcuts to naturally occurring and semantically loaded signals.
blocks.zh: 对NLP的无常学习应用产生了好坏参半的结果. 在WILDS基准中,Koh等人(2021年)与若干其他方法一起评价了IRM,以提高稳健性,以适应自然发生的域和亚人口变化,包括NLP任务,但发现与标准培训相比没有一贯的优势. Dranker等人(2021年)更直接地关注自然语言推论,同样报告,当自然MNLI流派被视为环境时,其好处有限。 然而,当环境被明确构建成一种已知偏见的流行程度不同时,综合管理机制的表现更为有利,这强调了环境定义的重要性。 其他研究则更直接地根据NLP的特定目标调整了无常的学习. Peyrard等人(2022年)引入了一种变化无常的语言模型化目标,并在控制偏移实验中获得比跨广泛而多变的体型更清晰的好处. 为减轻人口偏见,周等. (2023)拟议的Causal-Debias,将偏差相关因素确定为非正因和标签相关因素为因果,对前者进行跨人口组别干预,并应用下游微调时的无常学习损失. 他们的实验表明,这种具有任务意识的制定可以减少陈规定型的联系,同时保留下游的表现. 总之,这些研究表明,当环境或干预措施明确旨在揭露有针对性的偏见时,无差别的学习最为有效。 我们的工作补充了这些方法,研究IRM的行为是否依赖于产生虚假关联的机制,以及将评价从受控的合成捷径延伸到自然发生并充载的信号.

blocks.en: Other mitigation methods rely on different signals to identify shortcut-conflicting examples. Group DRO minimizes the worst-group risk but requires annotations for the relevant subpopulations ( Sagawa et al., 2020 ) . JTT removes this requirement by upweighting examples misclassified by an initial ERM model ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , whereas LfF uses a deliberately biased model and assumes that spurious features are easier to learn than task-relevant ones ( Nam et al., 2020 ) . Bias-model approaches similarly reweight examples according to their compatibility with a known superficial heuristic ( Utama et al., 2020 ) . IRM uses a distinct source of supervision: rather than identifying biased examples directly, it suppresses predictive relationships that fail to support a common classifier across environments. It therefore does not require the shortcut to be explicitly annotated or easier to learn, but it does require the environment partition to expose variation in its association with the target.

blocks.en: Controlled shortcut injection makes it possible to manipulate a feature’s correlation with the label and directly measure the consequences of relying on it. Previous work has used this approach to study shortcut formation and evaluate model explanations ( Bastings et al., 2022 ; Pezeshkpour et al., 2022 ) . Following the environment-based formulation of IRM ( Arjovsky et al., 2019 ) , we construct two training environments in which a designated shortcut remains predictive but varies in strength, together with an OOD test environment in which its correlation with the label is inverted. Unlike prior protocols that treat injected artifacts as a single class of spurious correlations, we organize our environments according to the process generating the shortcut–label correlation. Following the causal terminology of Veitch et al. (2021) , we distinguish label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias, using graphical representations inspired by their framework. For each mechanism, we vary only the structural equation or sampling component responsible for the shortcut while preserving the task-relevant relationship. Table 1 summarizes the shared environment parameters, while Figures 2 , 3 , and 4 illustrate the corresponding structures.

blocks.en: To identify the minimal conditions for IRM to succeed, we varied the statistical disparity between training environments, defined as the gap in the strength of the spurious correlation across ℰ tr \mathcal{E}_{\text{tr}} ( Choe et al., 2020 ) . This disparity is the fundamental requirement for the invariance penalty: it creates the distributional instability that allows the model to distinguish unreliable shortcuts from stable causal correlation. Concretely, for a target gap Δ \Delta , environments are constructed symmetrically around a fixed center c c : p 1 = c − Δ / 2 p_{1}=c-\Delta/2 and p 2 = c + Δ / 2 p_{2}=c+\Delta/2 . For Label-Generated and Selection Bias, we fix c = 0.85 c=0.85 so that both environments maintain a globally strong spurious signal; only their differential varies (e.g., Δ = 0.20 \Delta=0.20 yields p 1 = 0.75 p_{1}=0.75 , p 2 = 0.95 p_{2}=0.95 ). blocks.en: 5.3 Robustness to Label Noise
blocks.zh: 5.3 标签噪声的强度

blocks.en: We investigate the models’ behavior as the reliability of the task-relevant signal is progressively degraded. By gradually increasing the label noise rate ϵ \epsilon , we artificially weaken the predictive power of the causal features relative to the spurious ones. This experiment is designed to determine whether a model continues to favor invariant features as the task-relevant signal becomes less reliable.
blocks.zh: 我们调查这些模型的行为,因为与任务有关的信号的可靠性正在逐渐下降。 通过逐渐提高标签噪声率 \\ epsilon, 我们人为地削弱了 与假象相比 因果关系的预测力。 这一实验旨在确定一个模型是否随着任务相关信号的可靠性降低而继续倾向于变化无常的特征.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 6 , increasing ϵ \epsilon progressively weakens the causal signal while leaving the shortcut configuration unchanged, making the spurious signal relatively more attractive for minimizing training loss. ERM succumbs to this bias. As the genuine signal fades, the model shifts its reliance to the shortcut, leading to catastrophic performance degradation at test time when the correlation is inverted. Conversely, IRM remains largely insensitive to label noise. IRM does not select features based on their relative predictive convenience, but strictly based on their structural stability. By rejecting correlations that vary across environments, IRM maintains its focus on the causal features, preferring a noisy yet invariant signal over a cleaner but unstable shortcut, even when the latter offers lower training loss.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We systematically evaluated IRM across label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Under controlled shortcut shifts, IRM consistently improves OOD robustness across causal tasks and succeeds in anti-causal settings with stable class prevalence. As the task-relevant signal weakens, IRM also remains more robust than ERM by favoring invariant predictors. Beyond controlled shortcuts, IRM improves OOD accuracy across all Bias in Bios profession pairs, with larger average gains for semantically similar professions, although semantic distance does not fully explain shortcut reliance. On ActorCorr, IRM reduces sensitivity to semantically loaded actor cues, but reveals an accuracy–invariance trade-off. Overall, IRM’s effectiveness depends less on the shortcut’s structural origin than on whether training environments expose its instability while preserving a stable task-relevant mechanism. These findings also show the importance of targeted interventions and class-specific metrics, as pooled OOD accuracy may conceal shortcut reliance. Extending this analysis to naturally occurring environments and fully fine-tuned language models remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们系统地评估了各种标签生成的特性、混淆和选择偏好。 在有控制的捷径转移下,IRM在因果任务中持续地改善OD稳健性,并在抗因果环境上取得成功,阶级流行率稳定. 随着与任务有关的信号减弱,由于偏爱变化无常的预测器,IRM也仍然比机构风险管理更强大。 除了有控制的捷径外,IRM还提高了所有比亚斯人职业对等的OOD精度,对相近职业的平均收益更大,尽管语义距离并不能充分解释对捷径的依赖. 在 ActorCorr 上, IRM 降低了对装入量的演员提示的灵敏度, 总的来说,综合管理机制的有效性并不取决于捷径的结构来源,而取决于培训环境是否暴露其不稳定性,同时保持一个稳定的任务相关机制。 这些结论还表明有针对性的干预措施和具体类别衡量标准的重要性,因为汇总的OD准确性可能掩盖对捷径的依赖。 将这种分析扩大到自然发生的环境和充分调整的语言模型仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: A first limitation concerns the controlled nature of our spurious mechanisms. Selection bias differs fundamentally from the other mechanisms considered here: it arises at the observation stage through conditioning on a collider, whereas confounding and label-generated features can be part of the underlying data-generating process itself. To isolate these mechanisms while retaining real-world text semantics, we introduce the corresponding shortcuts post hoc through controlled token injection. This design enables precise manipulation of the relevant causal relationships, but does not capture spurious correlations that emerge organically in natural text, such as environment-dependent shifts in style, lexical choice, or discourse. Our injected cues should therefore be viewed as controlled proxies for more diffuse real-world shortcuts, whose causal sources are substantially harder to isolate. A second limitation concerns the scope of IRM theory. Although IRM has been widely studied in classification settings ( Arjovsky et al., 2019 ; Ahuja et al., 2020 ; Choe et al., 2020 ; Kamath et al., 2021 ) , its original theoretical guarantees were developed primarily for regression. Extending invariance principles to classification remains an active research problem: subsequent work provides guarantees under more specific assumptions ( Ahuja et al., 2021 ) , while their applicability to modern Transformer-based models remains less well understood ( Peyrard et al., 2022 ) . A third limitation is that we freeze the pretrained encoder and train only a linear classification head. This choice deliberately places ERM and IRMv1 in the same fixed representation space, allowing us to isolate the effect of the optimization objective, but it does not reflect the fully fine-tuned setting commonly used with language models. This is particularly relevant because IRM can behave differently in highly overparameterized models, where additional capacity may permit solutions that satisfy the invariance penalty without yielding the intended OOD generalization benefits ( Rosenfeld et al., 2021 ; Gulrajani and Lopez-Paz, 2021 ) . Extending the present analysis to fully fine-tuned Transformers therefore remains an important direction for future work. Finally, our study is designed to compare causal shortcut mechanisms under controlled interventions rather than to benchmark IRM against the broader bias-mitigation literature. Evaluating the same mechanisms in less controlled real-world settings would enable direct comparisons with representative alternatives such as Group DRO ( Sagawa et al., 2020 ) , JTT ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , Learning from Failure (LfF) ( Nam et al., 2020 ) , and bias-model-based reweighting ( Utama et al., 2020 ) . Such comparisons would help clarify when the explicit environment supervision used by IRM provides advantages over methods based on group annotations or on identifying biased examples from model behavior.
blocks.zh: 第一个限制涉及我们虚假机制的控制性质。 选择偏差与本文所考虑的其他机制有根本的不同:在观测阶段,它通过对撞机的调节而产生,而混淆和标签生成的特性则可能是基础数据生成过程本身的一部分。 为了在保留现实世界文本语义的同时隔离这些机制,我们通过受控的符号注入引入了相应的快捷键后临时. 这种设计可以精确地操纵相关的因果关系,但不能捕捉在自然文本中有机地出现的虚假的关联,如风格、词汇选择或言论中依环境而定的转变。 因此,应当将我们注入的提示视为更分散的现实世界捷径的控制代理人,其因果来源更难分离。 第二项限制涉及IRM理论的范围。 虽然IRM在分类环境中被广泛研究(Arjovsky等,2019;Ahuja等,2020;Choe等,2020;Kamath等,2021),但其最初的理论保障主要是为回归而发展的. 将变化性原则扩展至分类仍然是一个积极的研究问题:随后的工作在更具体的假设下提供了保障(Ahuja等,2021年),而这些原则对以变形器为基础的现代模型的适用性仍然不太被理解(Peyrard等,2022年)。 第三个限制是,我们冻结预先训练的编码器,只训练一个线性分类头. 这一选择故意将机构风险管理和IRMv1置于同一个固定的表示空间,使我们能够隔离优化目标的效果,但它没有反映语言模型常用的完全微调的设置. 这一点尤其相关,因为在高度高参数化的模型中,IRM可以有不同的行为,因为增加的能力可能允许在不产生预期的OOD通化效益的情况下,找到能够满足变相惩罚的解决办法(Rosenfeld等,2021;Gulrajani和Lopez-Paz,2021)。 因此,将目前的分析扩大到经过充分调整的变换器仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。 最后,我们的研究旨在比较受控制干预下的因果捷径机制,而不是将IRM与更广泛的减少偏见文献相比较。 在控制较少的现实世界环境中评价同样的机制,将可直接与代表性替代品进行比较,如Group DRO(Sagawa等人,2020年),JTT。 (Liu等,2021年),"从失败中学习"(LfF)(Nam等,2020年),和基于偏见的模型再加权(Utama等,2020年). 这种比较将有助于澄清,当综合管理所使用的明确环境监督比基于群体说明或从模型行为中找出有偏见的例子的方法更有利时。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We exclusively utilize publicly available benchmarks in strict accordance with their original licenses for research purposes. Our methodology involves the artificial synthesis of environments through token injection; this process does not involve the collection of new personally identifiable information or the use of private user data. To minimize the environmental footprint of our extensive sensitivity analyses, we conducted all experiments using DistilBERT ( Sanh et al., 2019 ) , a smaller and more energy-efficient architecture than standard large-scale models.
blocks.zh: 我们严格按照其原有的许可证,完全利用公开基准进行研究。 我们的方法涉及通过象征性注入人工合成环境;这一过程不涉及收集新的个人可识别信息或使用私人用户数据。 为了最大限度地减少我们广泛敏感度分析的环境足迹,我们利用DistilBERT(Sanh等人,2019年)进行了所有实验,这个建筑比标准的大规模模型更小,能效更高.

blocks.en: In IRM theory, the algorithm exploits natural datasets collected from distinct temporal or spatial contexts to identify invariant correlations. However, since we synthesize our own environments by injecting misleading correlations, it is imperative to demonstrate the scientific validity of this procedure. This justification relies on the formal framework of Structural Equation Models (SEM).

blocks.en: Our protocol strictly respects these conditions. By injecting spurious variables without altering the intrinsic semantic link between the text and its label, we generate our training environments ℰ tr \mathcal{E}_{\text{tr}} via valid interventions by mathematically modulating the strength of these spurious correlations. This approach ensures that any observed failure of IRM stems from a structural limitation of the tested mechanism rather than a violation of the method’s core assumptions. blocks.en: Appendix D The Role of Causal Direction
blocks.zh: 附录D 因果关系的作用

blocks.en: IRM seeks a representation for which the same predictor remains optimal across environments. However, its formal guarantees rely on a connection between invariance and causality ( Arjovsky, 2020 ; Arjovsky et al., 2019 ) . The implications of this connection depend on the generative direction of the prediction task: causal learning ( X → Y X\rightarrow Y ) or anti-causal learning ( Y → X Y\rightarrow X ). This distinction can be understood through the Principle of Independent Causal Mechanisms (ICM) ( Schölkopf et al., 2012 ; Peters et al., 2017 ) . The ICM principle states that a causal generative process consists of autonomous mechanisms: the conditional distribution of an effect given its cause is structurally independent of the marginal distribution of that cause.

blocks.en: D.3 Implications for Our Experiments
blocks.zh: D.3 对我们实验的影响

blocks.en: Our anti-causal experiments are conducted with balanced and constant class proportions across training and test environments. This construction keeps P ( e ) ​ ( Y ) P^{(e)}(Y) fixed while varying only the association between the target and the designated shortcut. Under the assumed stability of P ⁡ ( X ∣ Y ) P(X\mid Y) , the optimal predictive mechanism can therefore remain invariant across environments. This design isolates IRM’s ability to reject unstable shortcuts without simultaneously introducing label shift. The resulting performance should consequently be interpreted as evidence that IRM can operate in an anti-causal setting under stable class prevalence, rather than as evidence that it is generally robust to arbitrary distribution shifts in anti-causal NLP tasks.

blocks.en: To ensure that our experimental design in the IMDB Genres setting is theoretically justified, it is necessary to establish that text description length is a feature that models can readily extract and exploit as a predictive shortcut. Linguistic probing and model analysis literature establish that sequence length information is preserved within sentence-level vector spaces ( Adi et al., 2017 ) . Consequently, when sentence representations are computed via token averaging (mean pooling), the resulting vector is directly bound to the sequence length N N , as embedding norms predictably decrease as sentences grow longer due to the properties of natural language distributions. Transformer-based architectures are highly susceptible to the sequence length learning problem whenever downstream classes exhibit asymmetrical length distributions ( Baillargeon and Lamontagne, 2022 ) . In these unbalanced scenarios, standard ERM objectives tend to opportunistically exploit sequence length as a primary predictive feature instead of relying on genuine textual or semantic information. Furthermore, because sequence length distributions effectively behave like a distinct domain or environmental property during training, a significant mismatch or inversion of these length patterns at test time routinely triggers an overfitting collapse ( Variš and Bojar, 2021 ) . Modulating this engineered length bias across training environments therefore provides a theoretically justified and rigorous proxy for evaluating the capacity of IRM to bypass surface heuristics in favor of invariant features.
blocks.zh: 为确保我们在IMDB Genres设置中的实验设计在理论上是合理的,有必要确定文本描述长度是一个特征,模型可以轻易地提取和利用作为预测捷径. 语言测试和模型分析文献确定序列长度信息在句子水平矢量空间内保存(Adi等,2017. 因此,当句子表示通过符号平均计算(平均集合)时,产生的矢量直接与序列长度NN相接,因为由于自然语言分布的性质,句子长得更长,嵌入规范预计会减少。 变形器建筑在下游班级显示不对称长度分布时,极易受到序列长度学习问题的影响(Bailgrangeon and Lamontagne, 2022.). 在这些不平衡的情况下,机构风险管理的标准目标往往机会性地利用序列长度作为主要预测特征,而不是依赖真正的文字或语义信息。 此外,由于序列长度分布在训练期间实际上表现得像一个独特的域或环境属性,这些长度模式在测试时发生重大不匹配或倒置,通常会引发过度崩溃(Variš和Bojar,2021年)。 因此,在培训环境中改变这种经过工程设计的长度偏差,为评价IRM绕过地表湿度的能力提供了一个理论上合理而严格的代名词,有利于变化无常的特点。

Each corpus is partitioned into an 80% training set, a 10% in-distribution validation set, and a 10% out-of-distribution test set. The training partition is further divided equally into two environments ℰ tr = { e 1 , e 2 } \mathcal{E}_{\text{tr}}=\{e_{1},e_{2}\} , characterized by contrasting spurious correlation strengths, so as to create the distributional instability required by the invariance penalty. We detail below the exact construction procedure for each of the three mechanisms.

blocks.en: Semantic distance is used only as a descriptive proxy for the availability of profession-specific information. It does not directly measure the accessibility of gender, the frequency of explicit gender markers, within-class dispersion, or the orientation of the learned decision boundary. Its role is to construct comparisons with different levels of representation-space separability, rather than to provide a complete model of shortcut attractiveness. For reference, the closest pair in the retained ranking is attorney/paralegal, with distance 0.0094 0.0094 , while the maximum observed distance is 0.1489 0.1489 for rapper/nurse. blocks.en: We additionally construct a six-class task to test whether the shortcut remains competitive when the prediction space contains professions from several distinct domains. Training environments are created using the same resampling principle, and the gender–profession association is inverted at test time. blocks.en: We use the same frozen DistilBERT encoder and linear classification head described in Appendix A . Biography representations are obtained using masked mean pooling over the final hidden states. Only the linear classification head is optimized. ERM pools the two training environments and minimizes the standard classification loss. IRMv1 retains the environment partition and optimizes the sum of the environment-specific risks and the invariance penalty. Both models are trained for 3,000 gradient steps with Adam and learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . For this experiment, the IRMv1 penalty coefficient is set to λ = 1000 \lambda=1000 . The larger penalty relative to the controlled experiments reflects the strong profession-specific semantic signal in Bias in Bios and the more diffuse nature of the demographic shortcut. All other model components are shared between ERM and IRM.

blocks.en: To measure shortcut sensitivity independently of pooled accuracy, we compare each review with its anti-correlated variant, in which the injected actor cue points toward the incorrect sentiment class. For each sentiment class y ∈ 𝒴 y\in\mathcal{Y} , we define the class-specific clean-to-anti-correlated accuracy gap as G y = Acc clean ( y ) − Acc anti ( y ) , G_{y}=\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{clean}}^{(y)}-\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{anti}}^{(y)}, (15) where Acc clean ( y ) \operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{clean}}^{(y)} is the accuracy on clean reviews from class y y , and Acc anti ( y ) \operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{anti}}^{(y)} is the accuracy on the same class under the anti-correlated actor intervention. Since ActorCorr is a binary sentiment-classification task with 𝒴 = { neg , pos } \mathcal{Y}=\{\mathrm{neg},\mathrm{pos}\} , this definition yields two class-specific gaps: G neg \displaystyle G_{\mathrm{neg}} = Acc clean ( neg ) − Acc anti ( neg ) , \displaystyle=\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{clean}}^{(\mathrm{neg})}-\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{anti}}^{(\mathrm{neg})}, (16) G pos \displaystyle G_{\mathrm{pos}} = Acc clean ( pos ) − Acc anti ( pos ) . \displaystyle=\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{clean}}^{(\mathrm{pos})}-\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{anti}}^{(\mathrm{pos})}. (17) Here, G neg G_{\mathrm{neg}} measures the accuracy loss caused by injecting the positive-associated actor into negative reviews, whereas G pos G_{\mathrm{pos}} measures the loss caused by injecting the negative-associated actor into positive reviews. These gaps therefore quantify how strongly the misleading actor cue affects each sentiment class. A large positive value of G y G_{y} indicates that the anti-correlated actor reduces accuracy, showing that the model remains sensitive to the shortcut for class y y . A value close to zero indicates that the intervention has little effect. A negative value means that accuracy is higher under the anti-correlated intervention than in the clean condition, indicating a sign-inverted response rather than straightforward invariance. We summarize the model’s average signed sensitivity using the Anti-Correlated Accuracy Change: ACAC = 1 | 𝒴 | ​ ∑ y ∈ 𝒴 G y . \operatorname{ACAC}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{Y}|}\sum_{y\in\mathcal{Y}}G_{y}. (18) Because ActorCorr contains two sentiment classes, this expression reduces to ACAC = G neg + G pos 2 . \operatorname{ACAC}=\frac{G_{\mathrm{neg}}+G_{\mathrm{pos}}}{2}. (19) A large positive ACAC indicates that anti-correlated actor cues reduce accuracy on average, suggesting reliance on the shortcut. An ACAC close to zero indicates limited average signed sensitivity. However, reporting G neg G_{\mathrm{neg}} and G pos G_{\mathrm{pos}} in addition to ACAC is important because the effect of the actor cue may be asymmetric across sentiment classes. In particular, a positive gap for one class and a negative gap for the other can partially cancel in the macro-average, producing a low ACAC even though the model remains sensitive to the intervention. Consequently, a robust model should ideally combine high clean and anti-correlated accuracy with both G neg G_{\mathrm{neg}} and G pos G_{\mathrm{pos}} close to zero. The aggregate ACAC measures average signed sensitivity, while the two class-specific gaps show whether that apparent invariance holds consistently across both sentiment classes.
